mentions.name: Technoetica
mentions.description: A collection of "technoetic" projects that apply technology to explore the nature of consciousness and the mind (noetics), pursued in a creative, artful, half-serious manner that stays open to both materialist and idealist explanations of the hard problem, including testing claims of ESP, psi, and magical powers.
mentions.problem: Exploring the hard problem of consciousness while remaining open to any explanation, from materialist to idealist perspectives.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm playing with various "technoetic" projects, meaning applying technology to explore the nature of consciousness and the mind (noetics) in the very broad sense, in a creative & wannabe artsy & half-serious manner that tries to be open-minded to any explanation of the hard problem
mentions.author: LawrenceKerr
